title: Socioboard
short_description: Open-source social media management and content marketing tool.
long_description: Socioboard is an open-source social media management and content marketing platform that streamlines social media operations with scheduling, automation, analytics, and team collaboration across multiple channels from a unified dashboard.

title: Soundraw
short_description: AI tool to generate custom background music by selecting mood and style.
long_description: Soundraw is an AI music generator that allows users to create custom music quickly and easily. It provides tools to generate unique soundtracks by selecting mood, genre, and length, without needing musical expertise.

title: Spline
short_description: Interactive 3D design platform for NGOs and SPOs.
long_description: Spline is a web-based design platform that enables users to create interactive 2D and 3D content for websites, campaigns, and digital communication. It brings design, interaction, and collaboration into a single environment.

title: Sprout Social
short_description: Full-featured social media management and analytics platform for teams.
long_description: Sprout Social is a social media management platform that provides robust solutions for managing and optimizing social media outreach and marketing efforts. It offers comprehensive features for scheduling posts, monitoring engagement, analyzing performance, and collaborating across teams, suitable for businesses and organizations of all sizes.

title: Squarespace
short_description: Hosted website and e-commerce builder with templates.
long_description: Squarespace is a website building and hosting platform that provides tools for creating websites, online stores, and portfolios. It offers customizable templates and features for content management and e-commerce.

title: Stotio
short_description: AI platform for pitch decks and strategic narratives using data-driven storytelling.
long_description: Stotio is an AI‑powered growth narrative platform designed to automate solutions such as pitch‑deck generation, data‑driven storytelling, and strategic content creation to simplify tasks such as developing investor pitches, crafting thought‑leadership assets, and aligning marketing narratives, all in one place.

title: Streak
short_description: Email-native CRM for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Streak is a CRM built directly inside Gmail, enabling nonprofits and social purpose organisations to structure donor communication and fundraising workflows without moving to a separate platform.

title: Substack
short_description: Publishing platform for email newsletters and paid subscriptions.
long_description: Substack is an online platform that enables writers to publish newsletters and podcasts directly to their audience through paid subscriptions. It provides tools for content creation, email distribution, and subscriber management.

title: Suno
short_description: AI music generator that creates full songs with vocals from text prompts.
long_description: Suno is an AI music generation platform that allows users to create songs with vocals and instrumental accompaniment from simple text prompts. It can generate music across various genres and styles.

title: Superset
short_description: Open-source BI and visualization web app for SQL data.
long_description: Superset is an open-source business intelligence web application for data exploration and visualization. It allows users to connect to various SQL-based databases and create interactive dashboards, supporting data analysis and reporting.

title: SurveyCTO
short_description: Secure, offline-first data collection platform for M&E and research
long_description:
SurveyCTO is a mobile-first data collection platform designed for NGOs, researchers, and development organisations to collect high-quality field data, run complex surveys, and manage monitoring and evaluation workflows in low-connectivity environments.

It enables teams to design advanced surveys, enforce data quality at the point of entry, and securely collect and manage sensitive programme data across mobile and web channels.

title: Synergy Connect
short_description: CRM platform for managing donor, fundraising, and programme data for nonprofits
long_description: Synergy Connect is a nonprofit-focused CRM designed for organisations to manage donors, fundraising, and programme data within a single system. It is built for ease of use and typically requires less setup compared to enterprise CRM platforms.

title: Synergy LMS
short_description: Learning and skilling management platform for nonprofits and CSR programmes.
long_description: Synergy LMS is a learning and skilling management platform built for NGOs, CSR foundations, and government programmes to manage training delivery, track learner progress, and support end-to-end skilling journeys from enrolment to certification and placement.

title: Synergy Skills and Learning Management
short_description: Skilling plus LMS platform for batches, assessments, and certifications.
long_description: Synergy Skills and Learning Management is a comprehensive skilling and LMS platform by SynergyConnect Data Innovations Private Limited designed to automate solutions such as program mobilization and course creation to simplify tasks such as batch management, assessments, progress tracking, certification delivery, and multi‑lingual content access, all in one place.

title: Synergy Survey and Analytics
short_description: Survey and dashboarding tool for M&E and real-time insights.
long_description: Synergy Survey and Analytics provides survey creation, advanced data visualization, and real-time monitoring dashboards to streamline monitoring & evaluation with actionable insights.

title: SynergyDonor - Donor Relationship Platform
short_description: Donor management platform for tracking donors and campaigns.
long_description: SynergyDonor is a donor relationship management platform designed to help organizations manage their interactions with donors. It typically includes features for tracking donor information, managing campaigns, processing donations, and facilitating communication to build and maintain donor relationships.

title: SynergySurvey
short_description: Flexible M&E data collection for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: SynergySurvey is a mobile-first monitoring and evaluation (M&E) data collection platform developed by SynergyConnect Data Innovations Pvt. Ltd., designed for Indian NGOs and CSR teams to collect field data offline, track beneficiaries, and generate programme insights through integrated dashboards.

title: SynergyWorks - Office AutomationSoftware
short_description: Synergy Connect
long_description: SynergyWorks is an office automation software suite developed by SynergyConnect Data Innovations Private Limited. It aims to streamline various administrative and operational tasks within an office environment, potentially including document management, workflow automation, and other productivity tools.

title: Synthesia
short_description: AI video creator that uses avatars and text-to-speech to produce presenter-style videos.
long_description: Synthesia is an AI video generation platform that allows users to create professional videos with AI avatars and voiceovers from text. It enables the creation of engaging video content without the need for cameras or traditional production.

title: Tableau
short_description: Data visualisation and analytics for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Tableau is a data visualisation and analytics platform that enables organisations to explore data, create interactive dashboards, and generate insights for reporting and decision-making.

title: Taiga
short_description: Open-source agile project management (Scrum/Kanban).
long_description: Taiga is an open-source project management platform designed for agile teams. It supports various methodologies including Scrum and Kanban, offering features for sprint planning, task tracking, backlog management, and issue tracking.

title: TallyPrime
short_description: All-in-one software for invoicing, accounting, inventory, payroll, and banking.
long_description: TallyPrime is a widely used accounting platform in India for managing financial records, GST compliance, inventory, and reporting within a single system. It is primarily desktop-based, with optional cloud access features, and is commonly used by organisations working closely with accountants and compliance requirements.

title: Tech for School
short_description: School platform combining HRMS, LMS, admissions, fees, and communication.
long_description: Tech for School is an all-in-one platform designed to automate solutions like HRMS and LMS to simplify school management tasks such as admissions, attendance, communication, fee collection, and report cards, all in one place.

title: Telegram
short_description: Encrypted messaging app with groups, channels, and file sharing.
long_description: Telegram is a cloud-based instant messaging service that offers secure and encrypted communication. It supports text messages, voice and video calls, and file sharing, often used for private communication and public channels.

title: Trello
short_description: Simple project management for nonprofits
long_description: Trello is a visual project management tool that uses boards, lists, and cards to help teams organise tasks, track progress, and collaborate in a simple and intuitive way.

title: Turn.io
short_description: WhatsApp communication and engagement platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Turn.io is a WhatsApp Business API-based platform that enables organisations to design, automate, and manage beneficiary communication workflows at scale.

title: UVDesk
short_description: Helpdesk for tickets, multichannel support, and knowledge base.
long_description: UVDesk is the customer support helpdesk module within the broader UVDesk help desk platform. It provides functionalities for ticket management, automated workflows, knowledge base creation, multichannel support (email, live chat, social media), SLA tracking, and analytics reporting within an integrated customer service ecosystem.

title: Vyapar
short_description: GST billing, invoicing, and basic accounting software for small nonprofits and social purpose organisations in India.
long_description: Vyapar is a GST billing and accounting application used by small organisations to manage invoicing, inventory, expenses, and basic financial reporting. It is designed for Indian users, with built-in GST compliance and offline functionality for environments with limited connectivity.

title: WATI
short_description: WhatsApp communication and engagement platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: WATI is a WhatsApp Business API-based platform that enables organisations to manage conversations, automate workflows, and engage users through structured messaging.

title: WhatsApp
short_description: Messaging and communication channel for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: WhatsApp is a widely used messaging platform that enables organisations to communicate and engage with users through chat-based interactions. Through the WhatsApp Business app and API, organisations can manage conversations, send updates, and build structured communication workflows.

title: WhatsApp Business
short_description: WhatsApp variant with business tools for SMEs.
long_description: WhatsApp Business is a free‑to‑download app from Meta Platforms, Inc. built for small and medium‑sized enterprises on Android and iPhone. It combines WhatsApp’s core messaging, voice/video calls and media‑sharing features with business tools—custom profiles, quick replies, automated greetings, labels and in‑app catalogs—to help companies organize conversations and serve customers more efficiently.

title: Wix
short_description: Drag-and-drop website builder with templates, hosting, and basic apps, no coding needed.
long_description: Wix is a cloud-based web development platform that allows users to create websites using drag-and-drop tools and pre-designed templates. It provides a platform for building various types of websites without requiring coding knowledge.

title: Wordwall
short_description: Interactive learning and assessment tool for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: Wordwall is an online platform that enables educators and organisations to create interactive learning activities such as quizzes, games, and assessments for classroom or remote learning. It supports engagement through gamified formats and reusable templates.

title: X (previously twitter)
short_description: Social network for short posts with text, images, and video.
long_description: X (previously Twitter) is a social media platform where users post and interact with short messages called “tweets,” supporting text, images, videos, and live streams, with features like hashtags and retweets to facilitate global conversations.

title: Xero
short_description: Cloud-based accounting and financial management for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Xero is a cloud-based accounting platform used by organisations to manage invoicing, expenses, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting. It is widely used by organisations operating across multiple countries, offering multi-currency support and integration with a wide range of financial and business tools.

title: Zabbix
short_description: Open-source monitoring for servers, networks, and services.
long_description: Zabbix is an open-source monitoring software tool for a wide range of IT components, including networks, servers, virtual machines, and cloud services. It provides real-time monitoring of performance metrics, availability, and alerts for system issues.

title: Zams
short_description: AI-powered platform for managing and optimizing digital marketing campaigns.
long_description: Obviously AI is a no-code AI platform that allows business users to build and deploy machine learning models without writing code. It focuses on predictive analytics, helping users forecast trends and make data-driven decisions.

title: Zapier
short_description: No-code automation platform that connects apps into multi-step workflows ('Zaps').
long_description: Zapier is a web automation platform that allows users to connect different web applications and automate workflows. It enables the creation of "Zaps" which are automated workflows between apps without requiring coding knowledge.
